title: RefugeBreakInput
description: Input to USMC 6200.1E §3.2 work/rest matrix. Returns the work/rest interval (in minutes per hour) prescribed for a worker at the current environmental flag and acclimatization state.

acclimatized.description: Whether the worker has completed the 7-14 day acclimatization period.

workMinutesRequested.description: Caller-requested work window in minutes. The spec's work/rest ratios are per-hour; this field is captured in the audit but does not affect ratio selection. Non-positive values are flagged in the audit as 'non_positive_work_window'.
